name: preferences_read
description: Read every shared MPCut setting in the key schedule, including the read-only local-control, agent permission, draft retention and cache limit values.

name: preferences_set
description: Change a native preference. Lowering history_max_steps immediately trims retained history in open projects. Refused while Settings → Automation → Let agents change settings is off. Local MCP control, the agent permissions, draft_retention_days and analysis_shared_cache_max_bytes are read-only to agents.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

value.description: The type, unit, range and special values of each key are in its conditional schema. Enum values match preferences_read.

name: project_drafts_list
description: List unlocked untitled project recovery files and last-modified times.

name: project_create
description: Create a new ordinary sequence or multicam project window. Supply local recording paths for initial import. Multicam requires a camera and opens the setup sheet.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_open
description: Open a saved MPCut project and wait for native document loading. An already-open document is activated.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_draft_recover
description: Recover an unlocked draft from a path returned by project_drafts_list.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_media_add
description: Add local recordings using the native editor. In a sequence, append or insert at index; in a multicam editor this opens source setup. Read editor state after partial import.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_save
description: Save the live project with native history. Supply a new .cut path for Save As. Writing over another existing destination requires replace_existing.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_close
description: Close this window. Specify what to do with unsaved edits; save requires a .cut path if the document is untitled.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_window_focus
description: Bring the specified project window to the front.

name: playback_monitor_visibility_set
description: Show or close the target window’s native video monitor.

name: history_panel_show
description: Show the native history sheet for the target project.

name: history_panel_close
description: Dismiss the target project’s history sheet and wait for the native sheet to close.

name: multicam_setup_read
description: Inspect the pending setup after a multicam import. Returns source IDs, picture/stream availability, and whether the project already exists.

name: multicam_setup_confirm
description: Confirm pending camera setup, optionally supplying source order, names, microphones and opening angle.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: multicam_setup_dismiss
description: Dismiss the pending multicam setup in the target project.

operation_id.description: Unique operation ID for identical retries.

name: project_operations_list
description: Inspect current native UI import/export/multicam workers for a specified project, including conversion started in that window. Omit project to inspect app-wide conversion. Scene/silence scans use analysis_editor_state_read.

project_handle.description: Target live window. Omit for app-wide project conversion.

name: project_operation_cancel
description: Cancel the exact native worker returned by project_operations_list. Supply its same project handle for window-owned work. An ended worker cannot cancel its successor.

project_handle.description: Target live window. Omit for app-wide project conversion.

name: workspace_notice_dismiss
description: Dismiss a native informational or error notice after inspecting it. Use its exact message so a newer notice remains visible.

name: recent_files_list
description: List the absolute local paths shown in Open Recent, newest first.

name: recent_files_clear
description: Clear the application’s Open Recent menu. Returns the remaining paths.
